name: Point & Portal
summary: A portal held on the controller is thrown to a spot pointed at with a curved pointer, even out of the user's line of sight by pointing through earlier portals; the user then reaches through the portal to press or grab things over there.
howItWorks: With Quest Pro controllers, pushing the joystick creates a 30 × 30 cm portal attached to the hand, and a curved pointer from its frame shows a ghost destination where it meets the floor; the joystick sets the facing direction and releasing places the portal's far end there. Pointing again through an open portal places the next one beyond it, so hidden places can be reached step by step; up to five portals can be open. The trigger links the portal to hand motion for fine adjustment and the grip detaches it. Objects at the far end are pressed or grabbed by reaching the hand through the portal. In a button-pressing task (25 participants) against Point & Teleport, it was faster with obstacles and needed fewer pointer actions, less movement and lower cognitive load.

relationships.note: Both reach remote objects through portals.
